fields.title: Terms of Service
fields.content:
Welcome to FMH Animal Clinic. By utilizing our veterinary services, you agree to the following terms and conditions. These terms are designed to ensure the highest standard of care for your pets and a clear understanding of our professional relationship.

1. Veterinary Services
FMH Animal Clinic provides professional veterinary medical care, including diagnostics, surgical procedures, and wellness treatments. While we strive for the best possible outcomes, medicine is not an exact science, and no guarantee can be made regarding the results of any treatment or procedure.

2. Appointments and Cancellations
Arrival: Please arrive 10 minutes prior to your scheduled appointment to complete any necessary paperwork.

Cancellations: We require at least 24 hours' notice for cancellations or rescheduling.

No-Shows: Failure to arrive for an appointment without notice may result in a "No-Show" fee or the requirement of a non-refundable deposit for future bookings.

3. Emergency Care
FMH Animal Clinic operates during standard business hours. In the event of a life-threatening emergency outside of our operating hours, please contact the nearest 24-hour emergency veterinary hospital immediately.

4. Financial Policy
Payment: Payment is due in full at the time services are rendered. We accept [Cash, Credit Cards, Digital Payments, etc.].

Estimates: We are happy to provide a written estimate for procedures or surgeries. Please note that estimates are approximations; final costs may vary based on the clinical needs of the patient during treatment.

Refunds: Due to the nature of medical services and supplies, all sales of medications and clinical services are final.

5. Patient Safety and Conduct
For the safety of all clients, staff, and patients:

All dogs must be on a leash and under control.

All cats and small exotic pets must be in an appropriate carrier.

We reserve the right to refuse service in cases of aggressive behavior or non-compliance with clinic safety protocols.

6. Limitation of Liability
FMH Animal Clinic and its staff shall not be held liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our services, except in cases of proven gross negligence.

fields.title: Privacy Policy
fields.content:
At FMH Animal Clinic, your privacy and the confidentiality of your pet’s medical records are of the utmost importance to us. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your information.

1. Information We Collect
We collect information necessary to provide veterinary care and maintain our business records, including:

Client Information: Name, address, phone number, and email address.

Patient Information: Pet’s name, breed, age, medical history, and vaccination records.

Financial Information: Payment details processed through secure encrypted systems.

2. How We Use Your Information
Your data is used specifically for:

Maintaining accurate medical records for your pet.

Sending appointment reminders and health alerts (e.g., vaccination due dates).

Processing payments for services rendered.

Internal quality control and clinic improvements.

3. Information Sharing
We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. Information may only be shared under the following circumstances:

Referrals: To specialist veterinarians or emergency clinics if your pet requires advanced care.

Diagnostic Labs: To external laboratories for bloodwork or pathology.

Legal Requirements: If required by law, such as reporting certain communicable diseases to local health or agricultural authorities.

Insurance: Sharing records with pet insurance providers at your explicit request.

4. Data Security
We implement industry-standard physical and digital security measures to protect your personal information and your pet’s medical files from unauthorized access or disclosure.

5. Your Rights
You have the right to:

Request a copy of your pet’s medical records.

Update or correct your contact information at any time.

Opt out of non-essential communications (such as newsletters).

6. Changes to This Policy
FMH Animal Clinic reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy as needed. Any significant changes will be posted on our website or communicated to you during your next visit.
